content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Bitcoin ebook

The core issue with platforms like PayPal and Stripe is their accessibility and fee structures. For instance, Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, which can quickly eat into your profits. By utilizing NOWPayments, you reduce transaction fees to only 0.5%. This significant difference means that with just 100 sales of a $97 ebook, you retain an additional $921. The infrastructure you will set up empowers you with complete ownership, ensuring you aren’t locked out or subject to arbitrary fees.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your ebook store, gather essential tools. You will need a GitHub or Cloudflare account for hosting, a NOWPayments account for processing Bitcoin transactions, and a method for file delivery, such as Google Drive. You should also prepare your ebooks, ensuring they are ready for upload. This foundational setup will streamline your deployment process, allowing you to focus on marketing your products instead of wrestling with complex integrations.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, start by configuring your NOWPayments account to accept Bitcoin. Integrate it with your chosen hosting platform, using either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up a Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Worker for backend processing. This script will automatically handle order confirmations and product delivery. Ensure your digital products are stored in Google Drive, allowing instant access once a payment is confirmed. This seamless integration guarantees you maintain full control over your sales process.
NOWPayments drastically reduces transaction fees compared to conventional platforms.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set up, it’s time to go live. Test your payment gateway by making a small purchase of your ebook to ensure everything works as intended. Monitor the transaction process from payment confirmation to product delivery. If any issues arise, troubleshoot them promptly. Once confirmed, promote your store through social media and other channels. Transparency about accepting Bitcoin will attract customers looking for alternatives to traditional payment methods.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully processing your initial transactions, focus on scaling your operations. Analyze customer feedback and sales data to identify popular products. Use this information to expand your offerings, adding more ebooks, courses, or templates. Consider leveraging the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for additional templates and blueprints that can enhance your store’s functionality. As your sales grow, reinvest in marketing efforts to reach a broader audience, ensuring your infrastructure can support increased traffic and transactions.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell ebooks online without PayPal or Stripe by creating your own digital store using sovereign infrastructure. By utilizing NOWPayments for Bitcoin transactions, you gain control over your sales and minimize fees. This setup allows you to keep more of your earnings while providing a seamless purchasing experience for your customers.
You maintain complete ownership of your sales infrastructure, ensuring sovereignty.

If you're interested in selling ebooks and digital products without relying on conventional platforms, check out the Complete Builder Kit ($197) available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This kit provides everything you need to build, deploy, and scale your sovereign digital commerce stack effectively.
Your Deployment Checklist

Create accounts on GitHub or Cloudflare for hosting your store. Set up a NOWPayments account to accept Bitcoin. Prepare your digital products for upload, ensuring they are ready for delivery. Configure your backend using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for automated processing. Test your setup with a small transaction to confirm everything works as expected. Launch your store and promote it through various channels.
